integrity: The finite census is given by standalone complete integer-graph enumeration, independently cross-checked by another decomposition and by separate float16/rational output comparisons; no independent external validation or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive finite binary16 state graph only, parameter 4, ties-to-even and specified operation order; one-rounding evaluator is idealized; uniform input distribution is over encodings, not Lebesgue length. Not generalized to other arithmetic semantics.
title: An exact rounding-circuit phase change for the binary16 logistic map
